mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, create_time, update_time, creator_id, updater_id, is_deleted, owner_dept_id, owner_id, version, definition_id, business_type, business_id, applicant_id, current_node_id, status
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_instances, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawn_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' AND applicant_id != #{currentUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS my_pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN applicant_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS my_submitted_count FROM approval_instance WHERE is_deleted = false
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM approval_instance WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT i.definition_id AS definition_id, d.definition_name AS definition_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM approval_instance i LEFT JOIN approval_definition d ON i.definition_id = d.id WHERE i.is_deleted = false AND i.definition_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.definition_id, d.definition_name ORDER BY cnt DESC
